                    let format_str = match &arguments[0] {
                        Expression::String(s, _) => s.clone(),

                                kind: TypeErrorKind::TypeMismatch,
                                message: "Semantic Error: First argument to std.Format must be a string literal".to_string(),
                                span: Some(arguments[0].span()),
                            });

                    let mut specifier_types = Vec::new();

                    while i < chars.len() {
                        if chars[i] == '%' && i + 1 < chars.len() {

                                i += 1;

#[test]
fn test_format_typecheck_valid() {
    let source = "
        func main() {
            mut name := \"world\";
            mut s := std.Format(\"Hello %s, your id is %d\", name, 42);
        }
    ";
    assert!(check_program(source).is_ok());
}

#[test]
fn test_format_non_literal_rejected() {
    let source = "
        func main() {
            mut template := \"Hello %d\";
            mut s := std.Format(template, 42); 
        }
    ";
    let res = check_program(source);
    assert!(res.is_err());
    assert_eq!(res.unwrap_err().kind, TypeErrorKind::TypeMismatch);
}
